title: Why leaving 8 items open is the right engineering call
text: Doesn't even track. Calling that one unknown source isn't a bug. It's correct. The fix, two feed agnostic synonym checks added after the existing rules, one for advisor related language, one for broker dealer and Reg BI language. I ran the updated classifier against all five live feeds. Unknown source dropped from 18 to eight. 10 recovered, zero items that were already correctly labeled got reclassified. The remaining eight aren't a bug I missed. They're generic pieces with no named regulator, or items about a regulator this pipeline was never built to track. Chasing those would mean guessing from vague text, trading a small real gap for a much bigger risk of mislabeling something with false confidence. I left it open on purpose. Not every fix should chase 100%. Sometimes the honest engineering call is knowing exactly where to stop and saying so. Fixed with Claude code, 10 recovered, eight left open on the record.
